observation.happening: Home screen of a task/productivity desktop app showing today's tasks and reminders. A right sidebar panel is open displaying AI recommendation information (Astra) with multiple action buttons and category suggestions.
observation.most_important: Central task list organized in clear sections (録音を始める, 今日の気にした方がいいこと, 得ていること, 返すもの) with timestamps and status labels. Each task shows source (Gmail, Outlook), duration, and priority.
observation.next_action: User can input a task in the text field at top, expand/collapse task sections, or click 'see details' and action buttons. Right panel allows toggling recommendations on/off.
anomalies: Right sidebar is information-dense with multiple competing action buttons (その止める, この推測を使わない) in similar blue styling, unclear which are primary vs secondary actions
Right panel text hierarchy is complex with many nested labels, categories, and status tags; difficult to parse quickly
Right sidebar takes up significant screen width, reducing space for main task content

concerns.what: Right sidebar contains too much concurrent information (multiple task categories, buttons, links, status indicators) creating visual clutter and cognitive load
concerns.where: Right panel: 約 18% of screen width contains 5+ action buttons, 6+ category sections, and multiple linked text labels

concerns.what: Action buttons in right sidebar (その止める, この推測を使わない) have identical blue styling but unclear semantic difference; primary vs secondary actions not distinguished
concerns.where: Right panel button group under each work pattern category

concerns.what: Right panel organization is flat; no clear prioritization between recommendation categories (働き方, 短く要点から, 仕事のパターン, etc.) or between action buttons
concerns.where: Right sidebar: all section headers and buttons appear to have equal visual weight

concerns.what: Right panel appears non-critical/advisory and could be hidden by default or toggled, reclaiming horizontal space for the main task list
concerns.where: Right ~20% of screen is dedicated to scrollable recommendation panel while main content is squeezed
